findings.detail: Native return code 3 breaks endpoint loop but does not latch science off. After accepted export/audit, remaining >780 seconds starts smoke even when the stop request was a soft RSS/time breach.
findings.title: Soft/time-stop latch still permits optional smoke
findings.verification: In-memory mocked run returned operations train-1000000, export-1000000, audit-1000000, smoke, archive with returncode 3 and stop_requested true.

findings.detail: Guard.run returns None for every operation including archive at <=600 seconds remaining; caller ignores archive return. Any monitored tool/resource failure sets failed and skips archival entirely. Archive exceptions occur outside the science try and bypass closeout receipt.
findings.title: Required archive cannot consume closeout reserve and is skipped after terminal failure
findings.verification: In-memory Guard.run archive admission with 599 seconds remaining and normal host returned None, did not spawn and left failed false.

findings.detail: A command whose RSS spike is missed by sampling can report a kernel maximum above the 4 GiB hard limit yet receive a complete receipt and permit subsequent science. Receipt peak must be evaluated before accepting command success.
findings.title: Recorded kernel peak does not enforce hard RSS breach
findings.verification: In-memory completed command with 5 GiB kernel maximum and no live sample returned complete and failed false.
